question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

LAX
solution:
The correct answer is **Negligent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The most appropriate synonym is **Negligent**.
 
 
• 
 It means marked by a carelessly easy manner. (लापरवाही से आसान तरीके से चिह्नित।)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, The fire was started by a negligent smoker.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct option is 2.
